audience: support and sales teams that run calls, contacts and dialer campaigns in CloudTalk

useCases.title: Review missed and recent calls
useCases.text: List the call history with filters for date, agent or status, then open one call to read its parties, times and outcome.

useCases.title: See which agents are busy now
useCases.text: Read the live statistics of each agent group and the current status of each user, such as on a call or idle.

useCases.title: Find a contact and read its tags
useCases.text: Search contacts by name, number or email, then open one contact with its numbers, emails and custom fields.

useCases.title: Create a contact and tag it
useCases.text: Create a contact or lead with its phone number and email, then add existing contact tags to it.

useCases.title: Tag a call after it ends
useCases.text: List the call tags an agent can use, then add them to one call. Tags already on the call are ignored.

useCases.title: Check AI Sales Dialer results
useCases.text: List the dialer campaigns and read the statistics of one campaign for a date window.
